sound_localization.md.title: Sound Localization — Biology and Robot Activity
sound_localization.md.description: Biology of sound localization (two ears, pinnae, interaural level differences); the robot challenge of approaching a pulsed-sound speaker using a directional external ear made of paper or clay; the phasic, omnidirectional, loudness-only sound sensor; two builds — a one-eared robot that rotates and compares loudness across turns, and a two-eared robot that compares left vs. right; calibrating ear directionality, averaging noisy measurements, and an optional stop-at-the-target extension.
